notes: Qty 59 as published (sections 8+4+15+6+11+10+2, plus three vehicles under 'Vehicles (2)').

Posted 'THERE IS NO TRY' dested the Dagobah Effect There Is No Try (not the There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement combo); Battle Order, No Escape, Secret Plans and Come Here You Big Coward are 2001 Effects (not Reflections III Defensive Shields).

Posted 'Boba Fett' left as the Boba Fett disambiguation (version not named); 'MARA JADE' dested Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'FLAGSHIP EXECCUTOR' Flagship Executor; 'ENDOR LANDING PLATFORM' Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay); 'Hoth Defensive Perimeter' Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker); 'tempest scout 3' Tempest Scout 3.
